sites.texte:
User-agent: *

Disallow: /dataset/rate/
Disallow: /revision/
Disallow: /dataset/*/history
Disallow: /api/
Crawl-Delay: 10

# Faceted search views are not useful search results and the set of
# filter combinations is effectively unbounded: every extra facet
# multiplies the number of distinct URLs, none of which are cacheable.
# Crawlers that walk them generate a full Solr query per request while
# adding nothing indexable, so disallow the filtered views and leave the
# canonical dataset, group and organization pages crawlable.
Disallow: /*?*tags=
Disallow: /*?*groups=
Disallow: /*?*res_format=
Disallow: /*?*organization=
Disallow: /*?*license_id=
Disallow: /*?*_tags_limit=
Disallow: /*?*_groups_limit=
Disallow: /*?*_res_format_limit=

# CKAN escapes the separator in multi-facet links as "&", which is
# correct HTML. A crawler that also treats ";" as a parameter separator
# reads the "amp" as its own parameter and re-requests the URL with a
# bare "amp=" appended. The reply contains the same escaped links, so
# each pass appends another one and the crawl space compounds; requests
# carrying fifteen stacked "amp=" parameters have been observed in
# production. The parameter is meaningless to CKAN, so refuse the URLs.
Disallow: /*?*amp=

User-Agent: *

Disallow: /en/search?*
Disallow: /recherche?*

Disallow: /*?*q=*

# Disallow: /*?arrondissement=*

Disallow: /*?*dc_*
Disallow: /*?*sioc_*
Disallow: /*?*mtl_*

### Calendriers

# prévenir le crawling dans les calendriers thématiques - on le fait déjà dans le calendrier global
Disallow: /calendrier-culturel?*
Disallow: /calendrier-expositions?*
Disallow: /calendrier-loisirs-et-sports?*
Disallow: /calendrier-participation-publique?*
Disallow: /calendrier-vie-de-quartier?*

Disallow: /en/arts-and-culture-calendar?*
Disallow: /en/exhibitions-calendar?*
Disallow: /en/sports-and-recreation-calendar?*
Disallow: /en/public-participation-calendar?*
Disallow: /en/neighbourhood-life-calendar?*

### règles par "section" du site

# Avis et alertes - ne pas indexer les alertes
# = on bloque tout à partir d'une "recherche", incluant la pagination
Disallow: /avis-et-alertes?*
Disallow: /alertes/*
Disallow: /en/notices-and-alerts?page=*
Disallow: /en/alerts/*

# Règlements (SN) ne pas indexer les règlements
# = on bloque tout à partir d'une "recherche", incluant la pagination
Disallow: /*reglements-municipaux/recherche*

### règles diverses - en vrac

Disallow: /*?fbclid*
